paper_title: Gas-rich dwarf galaxies as a new probe of dark matter interactions with ordinary matter
notes: Headline curve: thick black 'Leo T gas temp.' bound in Fig. 2 (figs/ULDP.pdf of the e-print), the paper's main hidden-photon-DM result (stronger than all previous literature for m < 1e-10 eV). The paper's kinetic mixing parameter g is the standard dimensionless kinetic mixing (chi); formalism of Dubovsky & Hernandez adopted in Appendix E. Curve extracted from vector paths: two exact power-law segments in log-log, g ∝ 1/m below and g ∝ m above a vertex at m ≈ 1.32e-12 eV (Leo T plasma frequency), g_min ≈ 6.0e-11; reported over the plotted range 1e-20 to 1e-8 eV. Axis calibration from labeled decade ticks. Bound uses Leo T's own Burkert-profile DM density (not the local DM density), so no rescaling to rho=0.45 GeV/cm3 applies; dm_density_assumed set to null. The paper quotes no confidence level: the limit is the conservative requirement that DM heating not exceed the gas radiative cooling rate. The blue G33.4-8.0 MW-cloud curve and the DM Radio projection in the same figure were not used.
